hero.title: Assessments students <hl>love</hl> to take
hero.sub: Create engaging quizzes in seconds with AI, run them live or as homework and see exactly where every student needs help.

assessments.title: Interactive assessments
assessments.text: Multiple choice, multi-select, fill in the blank, reorder, match, polls, open ended and drawing questions.

ai.title: AI that saves hours
ai.text: Turn a topic, a PDF, a Word file or a photo of a worksheet into a ready-to-play quiz with a multimodal Gemma model.

games.title: Live & self-paced games
games.text: Host teacher-led sessions on the big screen or let students play at their own pace with a live leaderboard.

reports.title: Instant reports
reports.text: Accuracy per student and per question, answer distributions and AI-assisted grading of open ended answers.

content.title: Bring your content
content.text: Upload documents, paste text or share a link. Edit everything before you publish.

homework.title: Homework mode
homework.text: Assign quizzes with a deadline and a join code. Students can join from any device.

footer: Wayground clone — built for learning purposes.
